labels.value: testcase(id='TC-ADMIN-001', name='Admin can create, edit, and delete a system user', plan='Exercise the full CRUD lifecycle of a System User in OrangeHRM's Admin > User Management screen, confirming that create, search, edit, and delete operations each land in the expected UI state.', steps=['Log in to OrangeHRM as an Admin user.', 'Navigate to Admin > User Management and wait for the list to render.', 'Open the Add User form and capture an existing employee name from the autocomplete.', 'Create a new user with a unique username, Admin role, Enabled status, and a random password.', "Search for the new username and verify exactly '(1) Record Found'.", 'Edit the user — rename to a new unique username and set status to Disabled.', "Search for the new username and verify it is visible; search for the old username and verify 'No Records Found'.", 'Delete the (renamed) user via the trash icon and confirm the deletion dialog.', "Search for the deleted username and verify 'No Records Found'."])
